title: Among posts by Harvey Motulsky and Noah Snyder, which one has higher popula
question:
Among posts by Harvey Motulsky and Noah Snyder, which one has higher popularity?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Has higher popularity means the post has higher view count ; calculation = MAX(SUM(ViewCount)) where DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR DisplayName = 'Noah Snyder';

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    u.XCL_057 AS DisplayName,
    COUNT(v.XCL_066) AS Popularity
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
JOIN votes v ON p.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
WHERE u.XCL_057 IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY u.XCL_052, u.XCL_057
ORDER BY Popularity DESC
LIMIT 1

ORDER BY SUM(p.XCL_031) DESC
LIMIT 1;
